name: Erik Faraday
source: The son of Wilshire Corporation’s director, and Sho’s (current) employer. He has a strong sense of duty, but is also as cut-throat merciless as his job dictates. His father was a passionate leader who managed to bring his company to a flourishing state in this utter ruin of a country in a mere few decades.
